3. Taking note of the office instructions dated 09.01.2025, the notification of even date and the submissions s made for the petitioner, present contempt proceedings are closed.

Notices issued to the respondents are discharged, however, liberty is reserved to the petitioner to seek appropriate remedy for redressal of his surviving grievances, if any, in case necessity so arises in future.
Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, also to stand disposed of.
